deviations: The worktree was created from main (4f1ab2b, the legacy site) instead of the integration branch; the local branch was reset to a4625f7 (integration HEAD) before any work.

The lobby intro paragraph is hidden below 480 px (like the card caption, EXPERIENCE §5.8 and §9.2). Measured: at 360x640 and 390x844 the paragraph is about twice the h1's area and would otherwise be the LCP element (WP-10 A5, EXPERIENCE §8.6). The lead sentence and the static hint stay. See openQuestions.

The entry statically imports four pure, three-free modules under src/museum/: rail/navigation.ts (travelTo, enterWing, exitWing, which the brief requires the HUD and door card to call), rail/progress.ts (the bead and phone bar read progress.current), rail/layout.ts (computeLayout for layout.ageT paper colors and year ticks, which the brief requires) and quality/tiers.ts (chooseTier, required in main.tsx). The Forbidden line was read as 'never MuseumCanvas, the scene or three.js': the canvas is reached only through MuseumGate's import(), and check-budgets shows an 87 KB entry with the museum chunk separate.

404 styles are global `.nf-*` rules in src/app/global.css, not a CSS module: dist/404.html links the gallery stylesheet and nothing imports NotFound on the client, so a module's CSS would never reach a bundle.

The loading row's percentage is derived, not a download meter: 10% once the museum chunk is requested, 40% once it arrived, then 40 + 55 x the share of the peak (compilePending + textPending) already done; it hides at ready and on failure. It stays at 40% until WP-08 and WP-09 write ready.
The <!--preload--> marker is left as is (font preload hints are WP-28's).

Wing HUD, minimal: inside a wing the rail shows the wing's exhibit dots, 'Projects wing, 1 of 2' and 'Return to the aisle' (exit-wing, calls exitWing); on phones only that control shows. WP-27 polishes the phone version.
The HUD wordmark is hidden below 640 px so the year chip, PDF and Classic fit at 360 px.

New UI strings beyond EXPERIENCE §8.4: the fallback notice ('The gallery couldn't load. The resume is still here:' with 'Classic resume' and 'Resume (PDF)'), a second noscript sentence ('The PDF is at /resume.pdf.', since the brief asks for both links), the /resume/ title 'Resume | Chukwuemeka (Emeka) Nduka-Nwagbo' with CONTENT_DRAFT §6.6's suggested description, and the 404 meta description (its body sentence). No facts about Emeka were added.
Lucide paths were copied from the lucide-static 1.57.0 tarball (npm pack into a scratch folder; nothing installed). The ISC credit goes in public/credits.html (WP-28).
LCP is measured with JS on (a PerformanceObserver cannot run with JS off); the JS-off check is the bounding boxes.
